answer: Enrollment accepts one anonymous membership token per TPM: when an agent requests its first payout, the verifier checks a fresh hardware signature and rejects any device nullifier already registered, without exposing its serial number. Thus one board cannot mint many identities for free. Proposed attestation fee: $0.80 per identity × 1,000 = $800, versus a proposed $0.80 one-time check for one honest agent. A rover mapping an oasis on a mesa orchard can keep its data private. Limitation: hardware farms still scale, and software-only agents are excluded.
